# Support dark mode

## Behavior
- The app offers a dark color theme.
- By default it follows the OS/system color-scheme preference.
- A manual toggle lets the user override the system preference, and the choice persists across restarts.

## Out of scope
- Custom/user-defined themes or color palettes beyond light and dark.
- Redesigning existing layouts or components beyond recoloring them.
EOF
